corrections.caveats: Enricher: cudaMallocHost pinning of 1-4 GB happens outside the timed region, which favours the streams version; the no-streams program times one pass while the streams figure is a 10-run average; memcpy_benchmark.cu measures pinned bandwidth only, so the repo never separates the pinned-memory gain from the overlap gain. No CUDA error checks; checkResult's 1e-3 tolerance can print false mismatches; no tail handling for sizes that are not a multiple of the chunk. Upside: chunking lets the matrix exceed GPU memory. CMakeLists set no flags, build type or CUDA architectures.
